fact: The health ministry officially launched on 6 June 2025 'Guinea Salud', an AI chatbot answering the public on vaccines, medical evacuation, clinic licensing and HIV, in a pilot phase.

Africanian reports that the transport and AI ministry has funded a pilot in which UNGE and INSTTIC students build and operate the country's first AI-integrated meteorological station, training starting 21 July 2025 for five months, with a nationwide network the stated goal.
